content:

The Anthropic IPO, planned for the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, is highly anticipated, but it comes at an interesting time with technology stocks trading lower and Nvidia Corp. facing a scandal involving CEO Jensen Huang . Market expert Jay Woods suggests that Anthropic could learn from the recent SpaceX IPO.

The Anthropic IPO is expected to happen next week, after the company filed plans for a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, below the roughly $2 trillion discussed months ago.

"They are at the point of no return where they got to get it going and maybe the retail investor will pay off because it will price lower than it really should have," Woods, chief market strategist at Freedom Capital Markets, told Benzinga.

Woods said he is wary of any company whose S-1 filing says it could cause the end of humanity as we know it.

"These are not things that I really want to hear in an S1 filing."

The market expert says the lower valuation is a welcome sign from the company after it previously said it wanted to be bigger than SpaceX and have the biggest IPO in the world.

"Now things have shifted and now they just want to get this done and they want to launch before Thanksgiving."

Woods said he was thinking $1.5 trillion for the valuation and he's not sure where the company came up with a $2 trillion valuation originally.

Anthropic's IPO is scheduled to happen on Nov. 19, which comes after Nvidia reports quarterly results on Nov. 17 and possibly after Huang faces questions from Congress. Those events could put pressure on the technology sector and weigh on pricing and demand for Anthropic's IPO.

Woods said the backdrop of Nvidia is "not what Anthropic needed right now," but he doesn't think "it will have a dramatic impact."

SpaceX went public in June and saw strong demand from retail investors.

"I thought SpaceX was handled almost perfectly," Woods said. "We got the post-IPO pop. It sold off."

Woods said that SpaceX was also able to overcome big fears about future insider share unlocks. The IPO also priced under $2 trillion after originally planning that valuation, leaving some room for investors to buy below what many perceived to be the company's valuation.

The market expert said he's not sure if Anthropic's structure is the same, but insider selling could be a topic again for the new IPO.

"The retail investor, they've been waiting for this for a while, but maybe they're a little skittish."

Woods said some investors may wait for a better opportunity to buy Anthropic stock after watching what happened when SpaceX shares sold off after the initial post-IPO pop.

Building Wealth Across More Than Just the Market

Building a resilient portfolio means thinking beyond a single asset or market trend. Economic cycles shift, sectors rise and fall, and no one investment performs well in every environment. That's why many investors look to diversify with platforms that provide access to real estate, fixed-income opportunities, precious metals, and even self-directed retirement accounts. By spreading exposure across multiple asset classes, it becomes easier to manage risk, capture steady returns, and create long-term wealth that isn't tied to the fortunes of just one company or industry.

For accredited investors looking beyond stocks and bonds, EquityMultiple provides access to vetted commercial real estate deals starting at $5,000 , with only ~5% of opportunities passing their due diligence process.

Backed by Jeff Bezos, Arrived Homes makes real estate investing accessible with a low barrier to entry. Investors can buy fractional shares of single-family rentals and vacation homes starting with as little as $100 . This allows everyday investors to diversify into real estate, collect rental income, and build long-term wealth without needing to manage properties directly.

As AI coding tools take on more of the work traditionally done by developers, companies are facing new challenges around code quality, context and the rising cost of AI-powered development. Bito is building software designed to help AI coding agents better understand complex codebases while helping companies control AI development costs. Founded by former PubMatic executives, Bito has raised more than $10 million from institutional and individual investors and is now raising additional capital through a Wefunder offering, giving investors an opportunity to invest in a company targeting an emerging need within the rapidly expanding AI software market.

Farmland has historically held its value through market volatility and delivered returns uncorrelated to stocks and bonds. For accredited investors, FarmTogether offers direct access to high-quality U.S. farmland starting at $15,000 — fully managed, with no landlord headaches.

Private real estate and private credit can add income and stability to a stock-heavy portfolio. Fundrise offers access to diversified private real estate and credit strategies through an easy-to-use platform, with professionally managed portfolios designed to generate passive income and long-term growth.

chineseSummary: Anthropic 计划在纳斯达克上市，股票代码为 ANT，备受期待，但它发生在一个有趣的时刻，科技股走低，英伟达公司面临涉及首席执行官黄仁勋的丑闻。市场专家杰伊·伍兹...
chineseContent:
Benzinga 和 Yahoo Finance LLC 可能通过以下链接赚取某些项目的佣金或收入。

Anthropic 计划在纳斯达克上市，股票代码为 ANT，备受期待，但它发生在一个有趣的时刻，科技股走低，英伟达公司面临涉及首席执行官黄仁勋的丑闻。市场专家 Jay Woods 表示 Anthropic 可以从最近 SpaceX 的 IPO 中学习。

Anthropic 的 IPO 预计将于下周进行，此前该公司提交了估值高达 1.4 万亿美元的计划，低于几个月前讨论的约 2 万亿美元。

Freedom Capital Markets 首席市场策略师 Woods 告诉 Benzinga：“他们已经到了无法回头的地步，他们必须继续前进，也许散户投资者会得到回报，因为它的价格会低于实际水平。”

伍兹表示，他对任何 S-1 文件称其可能导致我们所知的人类终结的公司持谨慎态度。

“这些并不是我真正想在 S1 文件中听到的内容。”

这位市场专家表示，较低的估值是该公司的一个受欢迎的信号，此前该公司曾表示希望规模超过 SpaceX，并进行全球规模最大的 IPO。

“现在事情已经发生了变化，现在他们只想完成这件事，他们想在感恩节之前推出。”

伍兹表示，他考虑的估值为 1.5 万亿美元，但他不确定该公司最初是从哪里得出 2 万亿美元估值的。

Anthropic 的 IPO 定于 11 月 19 日进行，此前英伟达于 11 月 17 日公布季度业绩，也可能在黄仁勋面临国会质询后进行。这些事件可能会给科技行业带来压力，并影响 Anthropic 首次公开募股的定价和需求。

伍兹表示，英伟达的背景“不是 Anthropic 目前所需要的”，但他认为“这不会产生巨大的影响”。

SpaceX 于 6 月上市，并看到了散户投资者的强劲需求。

“我认为 SpaceX 的处理几乎是完美的，”伍兹说。 “我们得到了首次公开募股后的流行。它被抛售了。”

伍兹表示，SpaceX 还能够克服对未来内部股票解锁的巨大担忧。在最初计划的估值之后，此次 IPO 的定价也低于 2 万亿美元，为投资者以低于许多人认为的公司估值的价格购买留下了一定的空间。

这位市场专家表示，他不确定 Anthropic 的结构是否相同，但内幕抛售可能再次成为新 IPO 的主题。

“散户投资者，他们已经等待这一点有一段时间了，但也许他们有点紧张。”

伍兹表示，一些投资者可能会等待更好的机会购买 Anthropic 股票，因为他们看到了 SpaceX 股票在首次公开募股后首次上涨后遭到抛售的情况。

不仅仅在市场上创造财富

建立有弹性的投资组合意味着超越单一资产或市场趋势的思维。经济周期发生变化，行业兴衰，没有一项投资在所有环境下都能表现良好。这就是为什么许多投资者希望通过提供房地产、固定收益机会、贵金属甚至自我管理退休账户的平台来实现多元化。通过将风险分散到多种资产类别，管理风险、获取稳定回报以及创造长期财富（而不仅仅是与一家公司或行业的财富挂钩）变得更加容易。

对于股票和债券以外的合格投资者，EquityMultiple 提供起价 5,000 美元的经过审查的商业房地产交易，只有约 5% 的机会通过尽职调查流程。

在杰夫·贝索斯 (Jeff Bezos) 的支持下，Arrived Homes 使房地产投资变得更容易，进入门槛较低。投资者只需 100 美元即可购买单户出租屋和度假屋的部分股份。这使得日常投资者能够多元化投资房地产、收取租金收入并建立长期财富，而无需直接管理房产。

随着人工智能编码工具承担更多传统上由开发人员完成的工作，公司在代码质量、上下文和人工智能驱动的开发成本不断上升方面面临着新的挑战。 Bito 正在构建软件，旨在帮助人工智能编码代理更好地理解复杂的代码库，同时帮助公司控制人工智能开发成本。 Bito 由前 PubMatic 高管创立，已从机构和个人投资者那里筹集了超过 1000 万美元，目前正在通过 Wefunder 募集额外资金，让投资者有机会投资一家针对快速扩张的人工智能软件市场中的新兴需求的公司。

农田历来在市场波动中保持其价值，并提供与股票和债券无关的回报。对于经过认证的投资者来说，FarmTogether 可以直接购买高质量的美国农田，起价为 15,000 美元——完全管理，没有房东的麻烦。

私人房地产和私人信贷可以为以股票为主的投资组合增加收入和稳定性。 Fundrise 通过易于使用的平台提供多元化的私人房地产和信贷策略，并提供专业管理的投资组合，旨在产生被动收入和长期增长。
